text:
APPROVE
The three extracted helpers keep the original logic and order: listing failures still record the directory and skip it, the file loop still stops at `maxFiles` before subdirectories are queued, and symlinked subdirectories are still skipped. That leaves `Files` with only the early return, the `while`/`&&`, and one nested `if`, well under 15, and the moved `CHA0004` pragma still covers every catch, so the build should stay clean.
